name: [KNIVES & MUSEUM] SPLATTER 🎨
desc:
CHAMELEON! 🦎
a round-based paint and seek camouflage game. Paint yourself into the environment, just like a chameleon!

🖌️ HIDER ~ Play as a hider, be clever, and blend yourself into the environment.🖼️
🔫 SEEKER ~ Play as a seeker, keep a watch, and hunt for the hiders. 🎨
🪙 GAMEPLAY ~ Earn coins from both roles, and unlock new guns, new knives, or rigs to match your spot better! 🔥


A Creative Conceptualist's Classic. 🌹
